title: Verbux
description: verbux.com zoominfo.com/c/verbux-soluciones-informáticas-limitada/457993216 Verbux is a Chilean IT company — Verbux Soluciones Informáticas Limitada — operating since 2001, headquartered at Juana de Arco Nº2012, Oficina 33, Providencia, Santiago, Chile (also verbux.cl). It delivers IT infrastructure, engineering, professional IT services, cloud computing, IoT and SCADA process-control solutions for industrial, mining and power-generation clients. Claims 1,000+ implemented IT solutions (from file servers to data centers with high availability), and is currently implementing ISO 9001:2015 quality certification.
